title: Copy, never mutate: props, state, hook args

slides.say: Props, state, and values you pass to Hooks are all immutable. Here is what that looks like in real code.
Do not write into a prop object. That gives inconsistent output that is hard to debug. Make a new value instead.
The same goes for arguments to a Hook. Copy them first. A Hook might memoize on its arguments, and mutating them would make that memo stale.

slides.text: State changes go through the setter. Prop changes come from the parent.
slides.say: Takeaway: for state, call the setter. For props, the parent passes new ones. Never change them in place.
